changelog: fix: a grouping can now hold fewer samples than the job, and the exported PNG is drawn at the size it is exported at. GROUPING 2 COULD NOT BE SET UP. Taking two samples out by un-ticking them left nothing to save: hiding is a chart setting, Save groups is enabled only when the GROUPS changed, so the button sat greyed out with no reason beside it. The grouping itself has to be able to say "these two are not in this comparison", and that is an empty cell in its column — which is also how dada2_pipeline.R reads it, since its levels come from unique(values[nchar > 0]). So an empty cell in the active grouping now leaves that sample out of the chart, saved in metadata.csv, and it stays out on reload and through a re-run. Nothing vanishes quietly: the Groups panel states how many samples the grouping leaves out and names it, the exported figure carries the same line under its title, and "Ungrouped samples" puts them back in a (no group) panel. A new button turns a hide into that blank in one click. The disabled Save button now says what it is waiting for and that hiding is not a change to the groups. SAVING UNDID EVERY CLEAR. Writing metadata.csv fell back to the file's old value whenever the in-memory map had no key for a sample — but for a grouping column a missing key is the user having CLEARED that cell. So "Clear groups" followed by Save wrote the original groups straight back, and taking a sample out of a grouping put it back in, with the UI showing the change and the file not having it. Grouping columns are now authoritative; columns this editor does not manage still come from the file so they are not lost. THE EXPORTED PNG LOOKED LIKE A SCREENSHOT. Mark widths and type sizes are tuned for the 900px on-screen canvas, and were being used unchanged on a 1240px export — proportionally smaller text and a thin bar stranded in the middle of a wide band, which is exactly what it looked like. Both now scale with the canvas, so the exported figure is the chart drawn at that size rather than the chart enlarged, and it reads like the R PDFs in r_plots/. Also: on an aggregated view the columns are GROUP names, and the new blank-cell rule was asking whether "Feed" has a value in the grouping — it does not, so every column was dropped and the group-mean chart came out empty. The filtering already happens inside the aggregation, on the real samples, before the means are taken. Tests: 16 drivers, 532 checks.
